---
title: "Schedule"
---

Class meets Mondays from 4:00 to 5:00 PM in KC2 213, September 28 - November 30, 2026. A kick-off bootcamp will be held Thursday, September 24 from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM in the KC2 Seminar Room.

Lecture slides are posted after each class (L00-L10). Each week also has a short set of **ungraded exercises** (Ex 1-10) - quick practice tasks to do on your own between classes; nothing is turned in. [Book](book/index.html) reading lists the chapters (Ch.) and reference appendices (App.) that are new reading for that week - *(review: ...)* marks earlier chapters worth revisiting, and *optional* chapters add depth but are not required; see the [Syllabus](Syllabus.qmd) for what each section covers. The **Downloads** column collects the files for that week - scripts and other materials used in class; they are also described on the [Example Files](Examples.qmd) page.
